name: Juri
source: Kabashima's girlfriend. With a cunning personality, she is willing to use her body for her needs. She loves sex. Wanting money, she often engages in compensated dating. For her entertainment, it doesn't matter how cruel she is. With what kind of poison fang does she try and get you!?
